name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: Fix password-protected RAR releases failing to stream: RAR5 AES-256-encrypted volumes (and header-encrypted RAR4 archives) are now decrypted using the password carried in the NZB's metadata instead of always being rejected as unsupported. Add an admin-only download button for a cached release's raw .nzb file. Also fix a packaging bug where the compiled plugin DLL's AssemblyVersion/FileVersion could drift from meta.json's version.
